output.reason: The upgrade guide says the wildcard view permission was removed and a role binding to the default `view` role was added [ev-01e97dc9c4df][ev-2bbc505de6bb]. The renders show that the permission removed is the */* (all groups, all resources) get/list/watch rule in the admission, background and reports controller ClusterRoles [ev-6af5be55b5f4][ev-0ae726bec846][ev-fbb2a078179b]. A bare name=* is too broad because kyverno.io/* rules are still in the target render [ev-686e3f03e42c], so the subject needs group "*" to match only the removed rule. The replacement is a role binding, not a permission named "view", so replacedBy is wrong and is dropped.

correction.statement: Kyverno 1.13 removes the wildcard view permission (all API groups, all resources: get/list/watch) from the Kyverno controllers' ClusterRoles. A role binding to the default `view` role is added in its place.
